stories.title: Musk says Tesla and SpaceX merger under active consideration
stories.summary: Elon Musk told analysts he likes the idea of merging Tesla and SpaceX and that the proposal is being examined. He said special committees at both companies have been formed but have not reached agreement on terms, and any deal would require shareholder approval with no guarantee it will happen. Musk cited Tesla’s approximate $1.5 trillion valuation and SpaceX’s $2 trillion valuation, noting the combined size would be among the largest mergers ever.
stories.why: A merger of this scale would have major market and regulatory implications.
stories.change: New high-signal event entered the brief.

stories.title: US and India Near Finalizing New Trade Deal, Trump Says
stories.summary: President Donald Trump said the United States and India are “pretty close” to completing a new trade agreement that will differ markedly from earlier pacts. The comment coincided with Secretary of State Marco Rubio’s visit to India and a meeting between Indian Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal and U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer to discuss the deal, following a recently finalized framework for bilateral trade.
stories.why: Trade developments can affect currencies, business costs, market access and the external balance of the economies involved.

stories.title: OpenAI acquires startup Orchestra Bio⁠ to beef up its biotech business
stories.summary: OpenAI on Tuesday acquired a four-year-old AI biotech software startup called Orchestra Bio, the company announced on its website. Terms of the deal were not disclosed, but the startup had reportedly raised around $20 million as of 2025 from backers like Andreessen Horowitz, Atria, and 8VC.

stories.title: Houthi missile strike kills 73 Yemeni security recruits
stories.summary: Yemen's government said a missile strike attributed to the Houthi movement hit a camp for internal security forces, killing 73 recruits. Local authorities reported the death toll and said the victims were members of the internal security forces.
stories.why: It highlights the ongoing risk to Yemen’s security personnel amid the conflict.
stories.previousTitle: Houthi missile strike kills over 70 security recruits at al‑Alam camp in Shabwa
stories.previousSummary: On Monday, the Iran‑backed Houthi movement fired three ballistic missiles at al‑Alam training camp near Ataq in Yemen’s central Shabwa province, killing more than 70 internal security recruits. Yemen’s Saudi‑backed armed forces confirmed the attack, and Rashad al‑Alimi, head of the Presidential Leadership Council, condemned it as a criminal act and pledged a firm response, noting it occurred as pro‑government forces launched a major offensive in early October to retake western Houthi‑held territory.

stories.title: US official says India‑US trade deal close after meeting with Jaishankar
stories.summary: US Senator Marco Rubio said negotiations for a trade agreement with India are “very, very close” after discussions with Indian Foreign Minister Subrahmanyam Jaishankar. He said the talks covered energy security and defence cooperation, while noting that tariff and energy issues remain challenges, and his visit also included a tour of Reliance Industries’ refinery and meetings with Indian business leaders.
